# Rear swing arm hinge bushing lubrication fix

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Press a bushing into the swing arm and plug weld or add gussets for strength. [t199]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Press the new bushing into the swing arm.
2. Drill a hole in the center of the mounting plate to plug weld it for strength, or add gussets below.

_Procedure reported by [t199]._

## Parts

- Grease fitting, Zerk [t199]

## Specifications

- **Hinge bolt size**: 1 inch [t199] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Plug weld the center of the mounting plate to increase welding surface area. [t199]
- Add gussets on the bottom bracket to prevent twisting. [t199]
